candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Order checkout span is OK at 69ms and order metrics look healthy, so the fault is localized to payment rather than order; this narrows but does not contradict the payment latency candidate.
missing_evidence: Payment dependency-level traces/metrics identifying which downstream call exceeds deadline
Payment service logs with error detail beyond deadline-exceeded counts
candidates.statement: Payment service is the latency/error source: payment.authorize spans error at 1350ms, payment p95 is 1600ms with error_rate 0.004, and payment logs show 7 downstream_deadline_exceeded (504) events. Gateway's call to payment errors at 961ms, propagating checkout latency/errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within payment (external dependency vs internal) is not established; only payment-side latency/errors are observed.

report.explanation: Payment shows elevated p95 (1600ms), errors, and deadline-exceeded logs, with gateway's payment call erroring at 961ms; order and gateway metrics remain healthy. Evidence supports payment-side downstream latency as the bounded candidate; the specific failing dependency within payment is not yet identified.
